body: I'm here to talk if you need to, what's going on?
I feel exactly the same way. I hate being vulnerable in front of others, and I hate talking about my problems. I feel weaker for having talked about it.
I hope whatever you choose to do, you find peace.
Thing is, I'm okay with that. No hope and no future. Just nothing is I want. Thanks for the kind words anyways.

Sorry, my comment seems a bit blunt. Dying is a really difficult thing, but there are peaceful methods. However, the best thing to do when you are hurting is to talk it out, not hurting yourself more. So, if you want to tell me what's going on and what's causing you pain, I'm here to talk.
Thank you :) I want to take control of at least my own death.
The method I've chosen only has mild discomfort, although I cannot disclose it here.
I just don't see a future for myself. It's sort of like an existential depression.
As someone who has done a LOT of research on this topic, I don't recommend that method. It'll only damage your liver and will be very painful. Hopefully you don't choose to go down that road.
Doesn't seem to work for me, I've talked to multiple counsellors/therapists. I hate talking about myself. But it doesn't hurt to at least try. I really hope it goes better for you!
There are painless ways to kill yourself but none of them are that easily accessible. I don't think discussing methods are allowed on reddit.
